candidate.answerReason: The six fractions sum to 447/64, while 7 equals 448/64. Their difference is -1/64.

methods.label: Use denominator 64
methods.explanation:
Every denominator divides \(64\), so we can add the six fractions using that common denominator. Their sum is
\[
\frac{96+80+72+68+66+65}{64}
=\frac{447}{64}.
\]
Since \(7=448/64\), the original expression equals
\[
\frac{447}{64}-\frac{448}{64}
=\boxed{-\frac1{64}},
\]
choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
methods.levelReason: A common denominator and ordinary signed subtraction suffice; no series formula is needed.
